method: Both originally fixed seeds must retain a completed real process; at least one must actually collect a non-entry remain and extract to a settled base. Late/adjacent pickups require entry-to-terminal node changes and matching settled loot receipts. Empty returns and deaths never count as successful searches. All attempts, including original environment errors, remain in the record.
limitations: Controlled world/seed with copies of an actually earned save, geometry-assisted expert navigation. Does not establish novice usability, natural continuous economy, visual acceptance, performance, or source continuity to a later catalog; those need separate evidence.
